Source: Generated PDF 2.0 image fixture -- deliberate resource-limit probe, not feature coverage
QualityReason: Fixture declares a 10000x10000 8bpc DeviceGray image (100,000,000 required bytes) but supplies 1 byte of undecoded, unfiltered data. excise's #878 fail-closed guard (SkiaRenderer.Images.cs) refuses to paint from a buffer that cannot supply the declared pixels and draws nothing. mutool, pdftocairo and pdfium instead fabricate a full-size fill from the underspecified buffer and register as inked, so the corpus scan reads excise's correct refusal as MISSING_CONTENT (36/36 tiles). This is the safer behaviour, not a defect -- do not regenerate this fixture with a real payload; that would defeat the resource-limit probe it exists to be.
